_doc: Boss batch B3-land-beasts-plants themed pass (TEMPLATE.md sections 9 and 10): old bramblehorn (forest), dune wyrm (desert), jade jaguar spirit (rainforest). All three have art '-', so the identity rests on name, class, land and piece names. New motifs live in motifs/boss_boss-B3-land-beasts-plants.js (19 motifs, glyph/motion ids prefixed B3-, 3 custom chain effects: a bramble runner creeping along the outer loop with the antler growing at its tip, a sand ridge racing under the edge until the wyrm breaches at the next piece, the jade spirit jaguar bounding along the outer loop with two fading afterimages). All 3 signature motifs are new and used by no other creature. One composition motif here (jade-prints: the page's paw glyph blinking with a glowing trail). Reused where the picture is truly the same: honeydew-bead (sticky beads that well up and glint) in amber for Thicket Sap, sand-swim (sand-wave arcs as something swims beneath) for Burrow Under, rot-spit (heavy drops that fall and splat) in acid green for Dune Spit, jaguar-fang (L03, jaguar jaws gaping and crunching) in jade for Jade Throttle, quake-crack (L08, zigzag cracks splitting with crust chunks jumping) in sand gold for Quake. Every piece (unique, class, x0/x1) has a hand note with an explicit motif and layout; Sonnet's 7 flagged pieces are themed here (Thicket Dust = puffball spores, Thicket Ruse = eyes in the thicket, Dune Burrow = the wyrm surfacing here and there, Jade Pounce = the spirit cat bursting out and landing, Jade Canopy Drop = dropping head-first out of the canopy, Jade Stalk = glowing jade paw prints, Jade Gaze = floating spirit eyes tied in a trance).

old-bramblehorn.notes: Old Bramblehorn of the forest: an ancient thicket stag grown out of the wood itself, mossy and bark-dark, whose great antlers are bramble canes with hooked red thorns, pale bone tips and blackberries; roots for hooves, sap for blood, and the thicket hides its eyes.

u0.n: Horn Gore: a bramble antler drives the length of the edge tines first, red thorns hooking, the bone tips flashing white as they gore

u1.n: Bramble Mantle: arched bramble canes push out of the edge and hold, hooked red thorns along their backs and blackberries hanging under them

u2.n: Ancient Root: gnarled old root knuckles rise out of the earth, a green shoot unfurls from each and a bead of golden sap wells up

u3.n: Antler Wall: two mossy antler crowns lock tine through tine along the edge and brace, a sheen flashing where they cross

b0.n: Thicket Lash: thorny bramble lashes curl out of the edge in S-bends and crack, red thorns on their backs

b1.n: Thicket Dust: pale puffballs on moss tufts fly off the edge, are squeezed flat and burst rings of brown spore dust

b2.n: Thicket Mantle: a mantle of darker bramble canes lies along the edge and stays, bramble-blossom pollen drifting off it

b3.n: Thicket Sap: amber tree-sap beads well up out of the bark, glint and float up

x0.n: Thicket Ruse: leafy thicket mounds pop up at spot after spot, two amber eyes peering out and blinking, the leaves rustling

x1.n: Antler Crush: the bramble antler slams down out of the edge and crushes, soil clods flying, the tips flashing white

dune-wyrm.notes: Dune Wyrm of the desert: a colossal sand-gold wyrm of armoured rings with a round mouth full of inward teeth; it swims under the dunes, erupts out of a sand mound, opens sinkholes to swallow prey whole, shakes the ground, spouts sand and spits acid.

u0.n: Burrow Under: the wyrm dives and sand-wave arcs swell out from the edge as it swims beneath, a gold glint, then the sand settles back

u1.n: Quake: the ground splits in jagged cracks at spots along the edge, tied by taut lines, sand chunks jumping out: the foe stumbles

u2.n: Sand Swallow: sinkholes open out of the edge, sand rings sliding into a dark centre, and the round red maw snaps up out of the bottom

u3.n: Sand Spout: quick jets of sand shoot off the edge one after another, crown into spray and rain back down

b0.n: Dune Maw: the round mouth lunges off the edge face-on, rings of white teeth pointing in, the red throat irising shut with a snap

b1.n: Dune Tail-Whip: the banded tail whips out of the edge and the pale bone spike at its tip cracks the air

b2.n: Dune Plate: overlapping armour rings line the edge and hold, a sand-white sheen walking across them

b3.n: Dune Spit: acid-green globs fall off the edge and splat sizzling into the sand

x0.n: Dune Burrow: the wyrm sinks and its ringed head surfaces at one spot after another along the edge, sand dust puffing, never where you look

x1.n: Dune Heave: the whole ringed body heaves up out of a sand mound and crashes back down, sand clods flying

jade-jaguar.notes: Jade Jaguar Spirit of the rainforest: the ghost of a great jaguar carved in living jade, translucent green with gold rosettes and glowing eyes, the guardian of an old carved mask; it flickers between stone and spirit, stalks unseen, drops out of the canopy and holds prey with its gaze.

u0.n: Jade Gaze: floating pairs of gold-and-jade jaguar eyes hang at spots, glow rings pulsing, tied together by thin gold lines: the foe is held in a trance

u1.n: Jaguar Pounce: the jade spirit jaguar runs the length of the edge in bounding leaps, crouch, stretch, tuck, and lands with gold paw sparks

u2.n: Spirit Stalk: the jaguar drifts out from the edge flickering between solid jade and a pale dotted spirit outline, and the blow passes through it

u3.n: Jade Canopy Drop: the jade jaguar drops head-first out of the canopy, forepaws spread and claws out, leaves fluttering round it

b0.n: Jade Rake: four parallel claw gouges tear out of the edge diagonally, gold at the tips, flaring pale jade

b1.n: Jade Pounce: the spirit cat bursts out of the edge in one leap and lands back hard, a glint running over the jade

b2.n: Jade Poise: carved jade jaguar masks line the edge, calm and still, the gold rosette on the brow, a glint walking over the stone

b3.n: Jade Slink: the jaguar slinks low along the edge, half stone and half spirit outline, then bumps in

x0.n: Jade Stalk: glowing jade paw prints appear one at a time at spots along the edge and fade, the stalker itself never seen

x1.n: Jade Throttle: jade jaws gape off the edge, the two white fangs clamp shut and crunch

jade-prints.desc: glowing jade paw prints appearing one at a time and fading, a dotted afterglow trailing along the edge
